pencereler.0-5: Mid-flight, a jet lost every flight control at once. The tail engine exploded, and
pencereler.5-12: debris cut all three hydraulic systems. The crew steered using only the engine throttles. The cause was a hidden
pencereler.12-20: flaw inside a titanium fan disk. A crack grew from it for years. The backups failed because their lines ran side by
pencereler.20-30: side. The crash landing still left most people alive. Engine disks are now inspected far more strictly.

segmentler.metin: United Airlines Flight 232 lost all flight controls.
It took only a hidden flaw in a titanium fan disk.
So how could a hidden flaw in a titanium fan disk do this?

The answer is fatigue crack from a manufacturing defect shattering the tail engine's fan disk and severing all three hydraulic systems — and it is why engine disks now get stricter inspections and hydraulic lines got fuses.
